ACTION5.effect: Context-dependent interact. Branches at :1214 on whether the player is already in the carrying set: if so it drops (:1215); if not it scans two tag groups for an overlapping sprite and either attaches to it (:1220) or picks it up and removes it from the level (:1225-:1227). Like cn04's ACTION5, this is one action name with more than one verb behind it, chosen by board state.

branch_conditions.meaning: player is already carrying: ACTION5 means drop.
otherwise, first overlapping sprite of the first tag group is attached.
otherwise, first overlapping sprite of the second tag group is picked up and removed.

unhandled_actions.note: ACTION6, ACTION7 and RESET have no branch. ACTION6 and ACTION7 are not offered. RESET is handled by arcengine, which is not vendored.

sibling_builds.reason: wa30-ee6fef47 is the only wa30 build in either replay manifest and the only wa30 directory under docs/static/games/src/. The question does not arise. See dispatch/README.md.

notes: Every ACTION1-5 branch calls pfakmupgbr() first, which consumes a step of the budget. A move that is blocked still costs a step - relevant to any record about efficiency.
ACTION5 is a second instance of the object-dependent-verb shape cn04 supplied. Worth a tier-3 record if the recording carries a falsified rotate/pick-up expectation.
